I added a `unit` project to `vitest.config.ts` that runs `test/unit/**/*.test.ts`, and left the `integration` project as it was. I couldn't run the tests because the command needed approval that wasn't given, so this is checked against vitest's source code but not by a test run. You can confirm it with `npx vitest run --project unit`.

The unit project avoids the database setup because it sets `extends: false`, so it doesn't inherit the root `setupFiles` entry for `test/setup-db.ts`; in vitest 5.0.3, leaving `extends` out wouldn't be enough, because projects inherit the root config by default.
